answer_1.quote: Neural text generation is one of the extensively studied tasks of natural language processing (NLP), as it forms the basis for dialogue systems, machine translation, and text summarization... We conduct extensive performance evaluations on seven relevant metrics that quantify the diversity and quality of generated texts. We use the Transformer, an architecture well-suited for neural text generation.
answer_1.outputs: Generated continuations of text (100-token completions) evaluated for diversity and quality.

answer_2.quote: From seven total quantitative metrics we adopt to evaluate our model, Perplexity, KL-Divergence, and MS-Jaccard are closely related to the likelihood of generated texts. The other four metrics, namely Self-BLEU, Distinct-n, Repetition, and Uniq measure the text diversity.
